name: The List
tagline: Three lines in your own chat whenever a new bot lands in the directory
description: This bot posts a short note into the conversation you already have open, so keeping up no longer means going to look. Each note runs three lines and covers one fresh arrival or a pick from the directory. It sends no email and writes nothing for you; the whole job is telling you what has landed since you last looked.
author: Bill
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
